description:
Perform a headless crawl of https://quotes.toscrape.com/ using the Screaming Frog SEO Spider Command Line Interface (CLI). 

Goal: Run a command in the terminal to crawl the site without the GUI and export the 'Internal:All' report.

Requirements:
1. The crawl must be headless (no UI).
2. The output must be saved to the directory: ~/Documents/SEO/cli_results/
3. You must explicitly export the 'Internal:All' tab.
4. The target URL is https://quotes.toscrape.com/

Note: The command 'screamingfrogseospider' is available in your PATH.
